verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Devin can fix bugs, integrate with ticketing systems, and run in terminals/IDEs, but nowhere does it mention ingesting security alerts (e.g., from SAST/DAST/dependency scanners) or an automated validate-and-remediate-with-PR workflow specific to security findings. No security-scanning integration, vulnerability triage, or auto-PR-for-CVE capability is documented.
